guidance: Produce a short, implementation-ready feature brief. Keep scenarios concrete and testable. Prefer measurable success metrics over vague goals. Challenge fuzzy scope. Do not invent backlog fluff or version/changelog sections.

outline.title: Overview
outline.guidance: Group the problem statement and success metrics. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: The Problem
children.guidance: State the core user pain or inefficiency in 2–4 sentences. Name who hurts and what breaks today.

children.title: Success Metrics
children.guidance: List 1–3 measurable outcomes that prove the feature worked. Prefer numbers or clear qualitative thresholds.

outline.title: User Scenarios
outline.guidance: Group concrete, testable scenarios. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Scenario
children.guidance: Title each instance with the user goal or scenario name, not "Scenario".

children.title: Intent
children.guidance: What the user is trying to accomplish in this scenario.

children.title: Acceptance Criteria
children.guidance: Bullet list of specific, testable done-conditions for this scenario.

children.title: Edge Cases
children.guidance: Bullet list of failure modes, missing data, permissions, or empty states that matter here. Omit if none are known.

children.title: Exclusions
children.guidance: Bullet list of what is intentionally deferred or ignored for this iteration.
